description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in bPlugins Media Player Addons for Elementor – Media Player widget for WP media-player-addons-for-elementor allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Media Player Addons for Elementor – Media Player widget for WP: from n/a through 1.1.10.
